name: Memoni
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Thaplawala, Abdur Razzaq. 2009. The Memon Community: Heritage and Identity. Karachi: Memon Book Foundation. 241 pp. (Glottolog ref 318834). Part III 'Memoni Language', pp. 203-241; scanned PDF in four parts from memonpoint.com, scanned (Introduction + Part III).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: p. 211: 'In stress, intonation, and everyday speech, Memoni is very similar to Sindhi' -- impressionistic comparison only; no statement of where stress falls. Rest of the language part is nouns/pronouns/verbs tables, Roman-script spelling rules, prose and poetry.

sources.citation: Grierson, George A. 1919. Linguistic Survey of India, Vol. VIII, Part I: Indo-Aryan family, North-western group: Sindhi and Lahnda. Calcutta: Superintendent Government Printing. (archive.org scanned text, item;ernet.dli.2015.32108).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Memans appear only on p. 184 as Bombay immigrants returned as speaking Kachchhi; no separate Memani specimen or accent statement.
